goal: Prevent nodes from hanging or crashing when block storage encounters filesystem errors
Ensure fatal storage failures trigger a clean shutdown rather than silently stalling block relay
reviewability: Reviewing now is worthwhile as there are no pending changes invalidating review
agreement: Unaddressed objection: getrawtransaction under txindex masks storage errors as missing txs (w0xlt)
Unaddressed objection: introduces index regressions and leaves error handling inconsistent (maflcko)
Contested objection: returning nullptr for low-level file errors loses failure context (josibake)
Support for improved test coverage and preventing silent hangs during I/O failures (frankomosh, l0rinc)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it fixes edge-case message processing failures during filesystem errors
Replaces an ungraceful crash during block transaction requests with a controlled shutdown
Addresses silent request drops when relaying blocks to peers under I/O errors

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because it stops block I/O errors from bypassing fatal error handling during chain activation
Prevents nodes from becoming silently stuck when the block storage directory is inaccessible
Provides durable crash safety and reliability improvements for chainstate storage invariants
